jobs.title: Praktikum - Softwareentwicklung mit .NET (Web, Mobile, Client)
jobs.description:
**Unternehmensbeschreibung**  

AUMOVIO führt seit dem Spin\-off im September 2025 das Geschäft des ehemaligen Continental\-Unternehmensbereichs Automotive als eigenständiges Unternehmen. Das Technologie\- und Elektronikunternehmen bietet ein breites Portfolio für eine sichere, begeisternde, vernetzte und autonome Mobilität. Dazu gehören Sensorlösungen, Displays, Brems\- und Komfortsysteme sowie umfassende Expertise in Software, Architekturplattformen und Assistenzsystemen für software\-definierte Fahrzeuge. Die Geschäftsfelder, die nun zu AUMOVIO gehören, erzielten im Geschäftsjahr 2024 einen Umsatz von 19,6 Milliarden Euro. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens ist in Frankfurt am Main. An über 100 Standorten weltweit hat AUMOVIO rund 87\.000 Beschäftigte.

 **Stellenbeschreibung**  

Du bist auf der Suche nach einem spannenden Praktikum, bei dem du wertvolle Einblicke in die Welt der Softwareentwicklung mit .NET (Web, Mobile, Client) gewinnen kannst? Dann haben wir genau das Richtige für dich!


Für den Bereich IT suchen wir ab **März 2027** einen Praktikanten (m/w/d) für eine Dauer von **ca. 5 Monaten** zur Unterstützung unseres Teams.  

  

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören:

* Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Applikationen in unterschiedlichen Technologien (Web\-Applikationen, Mobile\-Apps, Client\- sowie Client/Server\-Anwendungen) und für verschiedene Fachabteilungen
* Objektorientierte Programmierung in C\# mit Oracle als Datenbank
* Mitarbeit in allen Aspekten der Softwareentwicklung: Modellierung, Realisierung von Backend und UI, Testen

  

**Qualifikationen**  

Du fragst dich, ob du für das Praktikum im Bereich Softwareentwicklung mit .NET (Web, Mobile, Client) geeignet bist? Hier sind wichtige Qualifikationen, die wir suchen:

* Du studierst im Bereich Informatik, Mathematik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Studienrichtung, damit du grundlegende Aspekte unseres Aufgabenbereichs mitbringst
* Du solltest bereits gute Kenntnisse in objektorientierter Programmierung mitbringen
* Du hast bereits Grundkenntnisse in Datenbanken und Web\-Technologien
* Wenn du Kenntnisse in C\# und Oracle mitbringst, wäre das super
* Du solltest mit MS Office vertraut sein und gute Kenntnisse in den gängigen Programmen mitbringen
* Sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind für uns unbedingt notwendig


Neben diesen fachlichen Anforderungen suchen wir aber auch nach bestimmten Eigenschaften und Fähigkeiten:

* Du bist eine Person mit hoher Einsatzbereitschaft, viel Eigeninitiative und einer schnellen Auffassungsgabe und kannst dich für viele Themen begeistern
* Kreativität ist für dich selbstverständlich und hilft dir dabei, unkonventionelle Lösungen zu finden
* Du bist selbständig, zielorientiert und strukturiert und weißt, wie man effektiv arbeitet, ohne den Überblick zu verlieren
* Eine sehr gut ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Teamfähigkeit sind für uns besonders wichtig \- schließlich müssen wir immer gemeinsam an Lösungen arbeiten


Bevor du deine Bewerbung abschickst, gibt es noch ein paar Dinge, an die du denken solltest: Wir benötigen deine **aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung** und deinen **aktuellen Notenspiegel** sowie ggf. eine Bestätigung deiner Hochschule hinsichtlich Ableistung eines Pflichtpraktikums, um deine Bewerbung bearbeiten zu können.


Wenn du nicht aus dem EU\-Raum kommst, sende uns auch bitte deinen **gültigen Aufenthaltstitel** und deine **Arbeitsgenehmigung inklusive Zusatzblatt** zu.


Die Bewerbungen von schwerbehinderten Menschen sind willkommen.

 **Zusätzliche Informationen**  

* Wir bieten dir eine interessante und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit als Teil eines **motivierten Teams** bei einem der größten Zulieferer der Automobilindustrie
* Wir legen großen Wert auf ein **angenehmes Arbeitsklima** und eine von fachlicher und persönlicher Wertschätzung geprägte Arbeitsatmosphäre
* Dein Einsatz bei uns wird **fair vergütet**: Wir wissen, dass deine Arbeit wertvoll ist und möchten sicherstellen, dass du angemessen entlohnt wirst
* Du wirst von unseren **erfahrenen Fachkräften** qualifiziert betreut, um dein fachliches Wissen und deine praktischen Fähigkeiten zu verbessern
* Profitiere von einer Vielzahl an Rabatten und Ermäßigungen über unsere **Corporate Benefits** für verschiedene Marken, von Mode bis hin zu Freizeitaktivitäten oder Technikprodukten
* Du hast die Möglichkeit an verschiedenen **Gesundheitskursen** teilzunehmen und kannst ein abwechslungsreiches **Sportangebot** wahrnehmen
* Nimm an regelmäßigen **Events für Studierende** teil, wie z.B. unseren Stammtisch, gemeinsame Mittagessen zum Netzwerken und austauschen oder lern die Stadt Regensburg bei einer Stadtführung kennen


Wenn du dich in unserer Stelle wiederfindest und Lust hast, mit uns an spannenden Projekten zu arbeiten, dann bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams!


Vielfalt, Inklusion und Zugehörigkeit sind uns wichtig und machen uns als Unternehmen stark und erfolgreich. Wir bieten allen Chancengleichheit – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, kultureller Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion, Weltanschauung oder sexueller Orientierung.


Sind Sie bereit, Ihre Karriere auf das nächste Level zu heben?


Die Zukunft der Mobilität ist kein Job wie jeder andere. Machen Sie daraus Ihre Aufgabe! **Werden Sie Teil von AUMOVIO. Own What's Next.**

jobs.title: Software Engineer (BIM Viewer)
jobs.description:
**About Capgemini**

Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Designing and developing the web\-based 3D IFC model viewer, from architecture through to implementation
* Exploring and evaluating relevant open\-source libraries and tools (e.g. IFC parsers, WebGL frameworks)
* Implementing model navigation features (e.g. object selection, section cuts, and property inspection, etc.)
* Collaborating with backend engineers on server\-side geometry processing and data APIs
* Optimising viewer performance when dealing with large, complex files
* Iterating on the viewer based on feedback from end users
**Requirements**
----------------

* Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript and backend JS runtimes (e.g. Node.js/Deno)
* Good understanding of 3D graphics and/or computational geometry concepts
* Strong problem solving skills and a desire to learn
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  

Familiarity with any of the following would be a plus:


* Web development (Frontend/Backend/Full\-stack)
* WebGL or related 3D frameworks (e.g. Babylon.js)
* Python and libraries like IfcOpenShell
* Building Information Modeling (BIM) concepts
* Geospatial data and information
* Agentic development workflows (e.g Claude Code)
* WebAssembly
**Let's talk about what's in it for you!**

  

Passionate people are Capgemini's Ace of Spades \- join us to discover a career that will challenge, support and inspire you. Working at Capgemini you'll find the rewards are more than just financial. You will work alongside some very smart and inspiring people on exciting projects and you will also enjoy incredible benefits. We offer flexible work practices and 40 hours of self\-development every year with a huge selection of learning opportunities to choose from.

  

As 'Architects of Positive Futures', Capgemini actively supports the community in 3 ways:

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** \- we believe diversity of thought fuels excellence and innovation, which is why we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of their gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, ability, intersex status or age. To support our commitment to diversity and inclusion, we celebrate special events and days of significance that are important to our employees such as Diwali, Bastille Day, Pride, IDAHOBIT, IWD and International day of people with Disabilities. Our Employee Resource Groups Women@Capgemini and OutFront support the grassroots passion of employees to drive our diversity agenda and effect change.

  

**Digital inclusion** \- at Capgemini we are using our skills to drive social impact initiatives focusing on helping society address the impact of the digital and automation revolution. We also provide employees with opportunities to give back to the community through charity projects and volunteer days.

  

**Environmental Sustainability** \- Capgemini joined the CDP's (Carbon Disclosure Project) prestigious 'A list' for its commitment to the Net\-Zero economy. We are focusing on helping our clients transform towards more sustainable business models and committing to reduce our own carbon emissions (GHG) by 20% per employee by2020 **.**

  

Recognized by Ethisphere as one of the **World's Most Ethical Companies** for the last 8 years in a row, ethics and values are at the heart of Capgemini's corporate culture and business. Embedded in our DNA, our seven values \- Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Team Spirit, Freedom, Fun and Modesty \- have remained the same since company inception in 1967\. To see how we bring these values to life, click here to listen to some of our employee’s stories.

  

Come join us, bring your whole self to work, create new possibilities for you, your customers and your community and help us to be Architects of Positive Futures.

jobs.title: Senior SW Engineer for Lab Connectivity
jobs.location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, CT, ES
jobs.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Who We Are
  
  

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action \- we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

You will be joining one of the Agile organisations in charge of designing, implementing, delivering and maintaining Reusable solution to simplify interoperability between diagnostics solutions (Roche and non\-Roche instrumentation, LIS, HIS, Edge Systems…) to simplify the development to reduce complexity, time to market, cost of ownership and quality of our internal customers within R Departments at Roche Diagnostics.
  
  

This position will play a critical role in the team, leveraging deep expertise in Connectivity protocols and solutions and supporting the design, development, deployment and validation of future connectivity solutions while maintaining the current base of deployments across Roche. As a Software Engineer, you will be also lead the ASDLC adoption and Ways of working in your team while preserving quality standards and good software practices. You are expected to show a good customer centric mindset.
  
  

For this you will prove experience in .NET Software Development, Instrument connectivity protocols and Interoperability in general. You can communicate effectively in English with people of different profiles, cultures and your mentoring skills shall contribute to continuous improvement and delivering excellent software efficiently.
  
  

You will be responsible
  
  

You care about your team, leading technical discussions and complex initiatives. You can influence decisions within your area of responsibility and connect naturally with business and architecture representatives to provide solutions to our customers. You are able to manage technology, business and reality to design future feasible and efficient solutions.
  
  

**Who you are:**  

* Healthcare Interoperability\& Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of healthcare and laboratory integration standards (e.g., HL7, POCT1\-A, ASTM, LIS/HIS) and connectivity solutions for diagnostics environments.
* Software Development\& Quality Practices: Proven hands\-on C\# .NET development background with strong expertise in software design patterns, object\-oriented design, TDD/BDD, unit/integration testing, and maintainable code.
* End\-to\-End Ownership\& AI Integration: Track record of full SDLC responsibility (from requirements to deployment), including integrating AI toolsets into development workflows and understanding cloud/frontend technologies.
* Technical Leadership\& Architecture: Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor developers, design robust components, and guide architecture/AI strategy alongside product managers and stakeholders.
* Education, Communication\& Soft Skills: Degree in CS or related field (Bachelor's \+ 6 years or Master's \+ 4 years), with strong problem\-solving skills, independence, and fluent communication in English and Spanish for agile, cross\-functional collaboration.


Locations
  
  

You will be based in Sant Cugat, Spain.
  
  

Leadership Skills
  
You are also responsible for building, and then providing effective leadership for your team. Doing so in a manner that is consistent with the Roche Values and leadership capabilities. You will seek to inspire and lead your team to create transformative solutions, and to influence their prioritization and uptake in the wider organization, in order to ensure that customer solutions are at the forefront of the market and deliver its optimal contribution to the Roche Diagnostics Vision.
  
  

Both Diagnostics and Diabetes Care Leadership teams usethese skills when referring to leadership. Consider bringing them into the job description.
  
  

The Expert SW Engineer in Mobile is expected to demonstrate the Roche Operating Principles and contribute to the Roche Group. The Roche Operating Principles are:
  
  

* Put patients first
* Follow the science
* Act as one team
* Embrace differences
* Accelerate learning
* Simplify radically
* Make impact now
* Think long term


Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

jobs.title: D365 Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Type:**


Permanent**Build a brilliant future with Hiscox**

  

Role Overview

  

Hiscox is expanding its use of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform to enhance business agility and operational efficiency across global units.

  

This role sits within the Group Platform Engineering team and is pivotal in delivering scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions using low/no code approaches, with a focus on Dynamics 365 and/or Power Apps Model Driven solutions.

  

You will work closely with solution architects, in\-house teams, third party partners, and business stakeholders to help design, configure, deliver, and support robust solutions aligned to architectural principles, policies, and guidelines.  



  

About You

  

You are a pragmatic and delivery\-focused specialist who can translate business needs into well\-structured solutions, communicating confidently with both technical and non technical stakeholders.


You’re motivated to stay current with emerging capabilities, trends, best practices, and security considerations that can improve the roadmap and team outcomes.

  

You enjoy collaborating with others, contributing to shared standards, and supporting capability uplift across teams and “community of practice” activities.  



  

You are ready to act as a “go to” engineer for a functional area or product slice—without formal line management—supporting juniors through collaboration and coaching.

  

Key Responsibilities

  

1\) Solution Delivery (D365 / Model Driven Focus)

* Design, develop, and deploy solutions using Power Platform, including work that supports Dynamics 365 and/or Power Apps (Model Driven) delivery.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications and deliverables, ensuring solutions are pragmatic and maximise technology benefits.
* Collaborate with the Technical Lead and solution architects to ensure solutions align with architectural principles, policies, guidelines, and the Microsoft upgrade roadmap.
* Ensure alignment with design standards, reusable components, DevOps pipelines, and lifecycle management practices.
* Collaborate with internal teams and Microsoft partners to ensure high\-quality implementations.

  

2\) Requirements \& Stakeholder Collaboration

* Work with business and technology stakeholders to elicit and refine requirements, shaping them into clear solution outcomes.
* Communicate effectively across technical and non technical audiences to drive shared understanding and delivery progress.

  

3\) Platform \& Lifecycle Practices (ALM / Environments / Operability)

* Contribute to application lifecycle management practices, with familiarity across waterfall and agile delivery approaches.
* Support ongoing improvement of platform usage and performance, helping ensure optimal configuration and scalability.
* Provide ongoing support and further development for deployed solutions.

  

4\) Data Model, Non Functional Requirements \& Quality

* Ensure extensions to Dataverse and the Common Data Model are introduced consistently with industry best practice.
* Ensure non functional requirements are identified and addressed, including secure configuration, access controls, appropriate environment sizing, monitoring metrics, and an effective support model.

  

5\) Security, Compliance \& Governance

* Implement and maintain governance policies such as Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and access controls, supporting compliance and security standards.
* Participate in regular reviews with partners and internal teams to ensure compliance and security standards are met.
* Support the development and enforcement of governance models, standards, and policies, contributing to continuous improvement and maturity.

  

6\) Team Enablement \& Knowledge Sharing

* Promote best practices and continuous improvement through knowledge sharing and mentoring in day to day work.
* Support community enablement efforts (e.g., contributing to how to guides, design standards, training content) where appropriate.


Essential Skills \& Experience

* Demonstrated experience defining, designing, developing, testing, and deploying D365 and Power Platform applications and solutions (functional specialist or developer background).
* Strong knowledge of Dynamics 365 CE and/or Power Platform, with understanding of appropriate use cases (e.g., Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio).
* Understanding of Azure cloud technology and the Azure security model.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical and non technical stakeholders.
* Self motivated with evidence of staying current on technologies, trends, best practices, and security considerations.
* Collaborative mindset, including experience working with others and contributing to team skill development.

Desirable Skills

* Microsoft certifications at intermediate/advanced level (e.g., Power Platform Functional Specialist Associate, App Maker Associate, Solution Architect Expert).
* Experience extending Power Platform using C\#, JavaScript, etc.

  

Why Hiscox?

* Healthy work\-life balance with our 35h/week and hybrid working system.
* Holidays: 25 days \+ 2 Hiscox Days (Extra two Annual Leave).
* Health insurance, gym allowance, pension plan etc.
* After 5 years work 1\-month sabbatical leave.
* Team spirit with many opportunities to engage and an open culture.

 *Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture*
